_README: Copy this file to appsettings.json and fill in your own values. The real appsettings.json is git-ignored and never committed. INFRA-CAP API — ASP.NET Core 10 + EF Core + SQL Server.

ConnectionStrings._comment: DEVELOPMENT (rumah). Untuk production JANGAN edit file ini di flashdisk — pakai appsettings.Production.json di server, atau set env var: InternalApp__ConnectionStrings__Default. Pemisah WAJIB titik koma (;).

Jwt._comment: WAJIB diganti di production. Minimal 32 byte, unik per environment. Generate: [Convert]::ToBase64String((1..48 | ForEach-Object { Get-Random -Maximum 256 }))

Seed._comment: Dipakai hanya saat tabel Users kosong (deploy pertama). GANTI password admin sebelum deploy.

Cors._comment: Origin frontend untuk mode dev (Vite proxy ke /api). Kosongkan di production karena same-origin (dua IIS application).
